Card Q&A.a: The "until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of their Digimon" part activates even if not DNA digivolving. The "place 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as the number of cards in your or their security stack at the bottom of their security stack" part only activates if DNA digivolving.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect activate when performing a non-DNA digivolve?

Card Q&A.a: No, this effect places 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as the number of cards in either your or their security stack at the bottom of their security stack, not the total number of cards.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect place 1 of my opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as the total number of cards in my or their security stack at the bottom of their security stack?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If your opponent has a Digimon with as high or lower a level than the number of either your or your opponent's security cards, you must place those Digimon at the bottom of their security stack for this card's [When Digivolving] effect.
Card Q&A.q: I have 5 security cards, and my opponent has 1 security card. Can I refer to the number of my opponent's security cards for this card's [When Digivolving] effect so I don't place their Digimon at the bottom of the security stack?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of their Digimon. Then, if DNA digivolving, place 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as the number of cards in your or their security stack at the bottom of their security stack.
Inherited Effect: ＜Partition (black Lv.4 & yellow Lv.4)＞ (When this Digimon with each of the specified digivolution cards would leave the battle area other than by your effects or a battle, you may play 1 each of the specified cards without paying the costs.)
Special Digivolution Condition: [DNA Digivolution] Black Lv.4 + yellow Lv.4: Cost 0 Digivolve unsuspended with the 2 specified Digimon stacked on top of each other.
